newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatia c.bank sells HRK96 mln bills, rates flat.
newsitem.headline: Croatia c.bank sells HRK96 mln bills, rates flat.

text.p: Croatia's central bank sold 96 million kuna ($15.4 million) in 35- and 91-day liquidity bills at a weekly auction on Wednesday.
The accepted rates were unchanged at 7.0 and 8.5 percent respectively and the bank received no bids for its longest maturity 182-day bills again.
The issued volume shrank from 234 million kuna at last week's auction as the banking sector reinvested little of the money it withdrew upon expiry of matured bills, a bank official said.
She put the net decrease in outstanding central bank paper at 51 million kuna.
Commercial banks had an unchanged 14 million kuna in Lombard loans, raised at 9.5 percent.

To help their liquidity which gets under pressure due to currency exchange operations in the summer, the central bank called a purchase of foreign currency today. It will inject kuna to the banking sector in two days' time. -- Kolumbina Bencevic, 385-1-4557075 ($ = 6.233 Croatian Kuna)
